name: River Scroll
description: A softly watermarked scroll of river-fiber parchment, pale and flowing like a ribbon drawn from a stream.

name: Marsh Scroll
description: A peat-stained scroll of marsh reed paper, earthy and damp-looking, wrapped in the hush of wetlands.

name: Papyrus Scroll
description: A classic papyrus scroll bound with simple twine, sun-gold and ancient, ready for forgotten lore.

name: Silverreed Scroll
description: A graceful scroll of silverreed parchment, bright and elegant, with a faint moonlit shimmer.

name: Starreed Scroll
description: A celestial scroll of starreed fiber, sprinkled with starlike sparkles as if the night sky were rolled into parchment.

name: Worldreed Scroll
description: A mighty scroll of worldreed leaves and fibers, vast and living, as if the wisdom of the wilds had been bound in place.
